_doc: Baseline functional-equivalence profile for Stage-2. outside_sha256 = sha256 of the EXE minus the LE fixup record table (STRICT: must stay identical). fixup_multiset_sha256 = sha256 of the sorted fixup-table bytes (same relocation set, order may differ after renames). residual_sha256 = sha256 of the EXE with every fixup site value AND the fixup record table blanked (RELOC: stays identical under pure COMDEF relocation; any real code/data edit breaks it). From the (now const-advanced) baseline build -- see _advance_note.
_advance_note: ADVANCED 2026-06-25 (src_refine closeout ISS-0019/0020). Prior baseline = original-equivalent production build (sha256 ab5f110a..., src commit f83ec3c9), byte-identical to the original FD2.EXE. New baseline = const-applied build (sha256 2f2e12da...): the 5 data_fd2_ui_*_menu_state_template arrays (0x53EF2/F02/F12/F22/F32) are verified read-only (zero game write-xref; the game copies each into a local stack buffer and mutates only the copy) and were made const per the project const-data policy. The change is a LOGIC-NEUTRAL data relocation (zero-init arrays move from the writable segment to the CONST segment; no code/instruction change, 0 undefined symbols). User-approved: verified semantic correctness (const) takes priority over byte-equivalence-with-original. The rebuild now intentionally differs from the original FD2.EXE ONLY by this const-template relocation; everything else stays byte-faithful.
